name: gateweave-mail
description: Gateweave Mail for an agent: verification codes, reading, sending with approval, addresses of its own and webhooks, over Mail's MCP server with an agent's key.

mail_url.title: Mail's address
mail_url.description: Where your Gateweave Mail runs, such as https://mail.example.com, with no path or trailing slash.

mail_key.title: Agent key
mail_key.description: The key of an agent in your Mail workspace, from Settings → Agents. It is kept in your system's credential store.
